newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay Bullion Exchange was closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival. Trading resumes on Thursday.
On Tuesday, gold 24 carat closed 35 rupees higher at 4,830 rupees per 10 grammes on fresh seasonal buying while the supply was at a low ebb.
Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) closed 400 rupees up at 56,500 rupees per piece. They were down 200 rupees per piece on Monday after gaining 400 rupees last week.
Silver (.999) finished 20 rupees higher at 6,980 rupees per kg as fresh industrial buying helped prices to bounce back. Silver was down by 40 rupees per kg on Monday. (Conversion $1=35.79 rupees)
